list.title: Sessions
list.subtitle: The slots that let users validate their trainings. Every session stands on its own.
list.results: {count, plural, =0 {No session} one {1 session} other {# sessions}}
list.emptyHint: Adjust the search or the filters, or create a new session.

row.seatsLeft: {count, plural, =0 {Full} one {1 free seat} other {# free seats}}

create.title: Create a session
create.subtitle: Pick the trainings it carries, the slot and the place. You may generate several sessions at once.

steps.trainingsHint: A session may carry several trainings. A user sees it when all of them are among their own.
steps.slotHint: Date and hours of the session.
steps.placeHint: Building and room only apply to onsite and hybrid sessions.
steps.tagsHint: Tags help find the session again. The common referential is proposed, you may type your own.
steps.repeatHint: Input shortcut: generated sessions stay independent and can be edited one by one.

trainings.emptyHint: Change the search or the business line.

fields.capacityHint: Number of seats of the session.

repeat.previewNote: Each session is created on its own: you will be able to change the room, the hours or the trainer session by session.

detail.independent: This session stands on its own: an edit only applies to it.

errors.timeOrder: The end time must be later than the start time.
errors.capacity: Capacity must be at least 1 seat and cover the {count} registered.

detail.notFoundHint: This session does not exist or has been deleted.

participants.title: Participants
participants.emptyHint: Register a user to start filling the session.
participants.attendanceHint: Attendance is taken on the day of the session, participant by participant.

enroll.title: Register a user
enroll.subtitle: Search a user then add them to the session.
enroll.emptyHint: Try another name or another address.
enroll.full: The session is full, registering will exceed the capacity.

cancelSession.title: Cancel the session
cancelSession.body: The {count} registered participants will be notified by mail and the session will no longer be proposed.
cancelSession.bodyEmpty: No participant is registered. The session will no longer be proposed.
